0x19ab453c.notice: Runs the access-control + crosschain-link module initializers. MUST be invoked via the diamond's `initialize` `_init` delegatecall.

params.admin: The address granted `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` (controls the link/handler registry).

natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for an ERC-7786 messaging diamond — seeds AccessControl (so the link/handler setters are admin-gated) and registers the ICrosschainLink interface (ERC-165). Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} inside the initializing window (so it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer; each `__*_init` guard passes because the window is already open). Companion to the {AccessControlInit}/{ERC2981Init} patterns — a first-class production deploy artifact.
